// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.26;
import {MidBlockFeeTest} from "peach-source/test/MidBlockFee.t.sol";
import {SessionLib} from "peach-source/src/rwa/SessionLib.sol";
import {Ramp} from "peach-source/src/core/Ramp.sol";
import {BaseHook} from "peach-source/src/hooks/BaseHook.sol";
import {PoolKey} from "@uniswap/v4-core/src/types/PoolKey.sol";
import {PoolId, PoolIdLibrary} from "@uniswap/v4-core/src/types/PoolId.sol";
import {StateLibrary} from "@uniswap/v4-core/src/libraries/StateLibrary.sol";
import {Currency} from "@uniswap/v4-core/src/types/Currency.sol";
import {BalanceDelta, BalanceDeltaLibrary} from "@uniswap/v4-core/src/types/BalanceDelta.sol";
import {Vm} from "forge-std/Vm.sol";

// Run only test_generateKyberSequence; inherited tests remain in the pinned source.
contract GenerateSequence is MidBlockFeeTest {
    using PoolIdLibrary for PoolKey;
    using BalanceDeltaLibrary for BalanceDelta;

    function q(uint256 n) private pure returns (string memory) {
        return string.concat('"', vm.toString(n), '"');
    }

    function test_generateKyberSequence() public {
        (PoolKey memory a, PoolKey memory b, PoolKey memory c) = multiPools();
        PoolKey[3] memory keys = [a, b, c];
        string memory cases = "";
        for (uint256 kind; kind < 3; ++kind) {
            for (uint256 variant; variant < 5; ++variant) {
                for (uint256 dir; dir < 2; ++dir) {
                    uint256 snapshot = vm.snapshotState();
                    PoolKey memory key = keys[kind];
                    Ramp hook = Ramp(address(key.hooks));
                    if (kind == 2 && variant == 4) {
                        SessionLib.FloorConfig memory peak = rwaHook.floorConfig(key.toId());
                        peak.closedSpike = 3000000;
                        rwaHook.setPoolConfig(key, peak, 6000);
                        vm.warp(1767623400); // Monday opening after a fully closed Sunday.
                    }
                    BaseHook.MidBlockConfig memory cfg = BaseHook.MidBlockConfig(
                        variant != 0,
                        variant == 2 ? 1000000 : 1,
                        variant == 4 ? 1000000 : 500000,
                        variant == 3 ? 100 : 15000
                    );
                    hook.setMidBlockConfig(key, cfg);
                    (uint160 price, int24 tick, uint24 pf,) = StateLibrary.getSlot0(manager, key.toId());
                    require(pf == 0, "expected zero protocol fee");
                    string memory row = string.concat(
                        '{"kind":',
                        vm.toString(kind),
                        ',"variant":',
                        vm.toString(variant),
                        ',"direction":',
                        vm.toString(dir),
                        ',"hook":"',
                        vm.toString(address(key.hooks)),
                        '","poolId":"',
                        vm.toString(PoolId.unwrap(key.toId())),
                        '","currency0":"',
                        vm.toString(Currency.unwrap(key.currency0)),
                        '","currency1":"',
                        vm.toString(Currency.unwrap(key.currency1)),
                        '","tickSpacing":',
                        vm.toString(uint256(uint24(key.tickSpacing))),
                        ',"timestamp":',
                        vm.toString(block.timestamp),
                        ',"liquidity":',
                        q(StateLibrary.getLiquidity(manager, key.toId())),
                        ',"sqrtPriceX96":',
                        q(price),
                        ',"tick":',
                        vm.toString(int256(tick)),
                        ',"protocolFee":',
                        vm.toString(pf),
                        ',"base0":',
                        vm.toString(hook.currentFee(key.toId(), true)),
                        ',"base1":',
                        vm.toString(hook.currentFee(key.toId(), false)),
                        ',"auto0":',
                        vm.toString(hook.autonomousFee(key.toId(), true)),
                        ',"auto1":',
                        vm.toString(hook.autonomousFee(key.toId(), false)),
                        ',"floor":',
                        vm.toString(hook.pokeFloor(key.toId())),
                        ',"cap":',
                        vm.toString(hook.maxFee(key.toId())),
                        ',"mid":{"e":',
                        cfg.enabled ? "true" : "false",
                        ',"t":',
                        vm.toString(cfg.midThresholdPips),
                        ',"f":',
                        vm.toString(cfg.captureFractionE6),
                        ',"c":',
                        vm.toString(cfg.midCap),
                        '},"steps":['
                    );
                    for (uint256 leg; leg < 4; ++leg) {
                        bool zfo = leg == 0 ? dir == 0 : (leg == 3 ? dir == 0 : dir != 0);
                        uint256 amount = leg == 0 ? 1e20 : (leg == 2 ? 2e20 : 1e18);
                        (uint160 beforePrice,,,) = StateLibrary.getSlot0(manager, key.toId());
                        token(key.currency1).approve(address(swapRouter), type(uint256).max);
                        if (Currency.unwrap(key.currency0) != address(0)) {
                            token(key.currency0).approve(address(swapRouter), type(uint256).max);
                        }
                        vm.recordLogs();
                        BalanceDelta delta = swap(key, zfo, -int256(amount), "");
                        Vm.Log[] memory logs = vm.getRecordedLogs();
                        uint24 paid;
                        bool found;
                        bytes32 topic = keccak256("Swap(bytes32,address,int128,int128,uint160,uint128,int24,uint24)");
                        for (uint256 i; i < logs.length; ++i) {
                            if (logs[i].emitter == address(manager) && logs[i].topics[0] == topic) {
                                (,,,,, paid) = abi.decode(
                                    logs[i].data, (int128, int128, uint160, uint128, int24, uint24)
                                );
                                found = true;
                            }
                        }
                        require(found, "missing swap event");
                        (uint160 afterPrice,,,) = StateLibrary.getSlot0(manager, key.toId());
                        uint256 actualInput = uint256(-int256(zfo ? delta.amount0() : delta.amount1()));
                        uint256 output = uint256(int256(zfo ? delta.amount1() : delta.amount0()));
                        row = string.concat(
                            row,
                            leg == 0 ? "" : ",",
                            '{"zeroForOne":',
                            zfo ? "true" : "false",
                            ',"amountIn":',
                            q(actualInput),
                            ',"amountOut":',
                            q(output),
                            ',"fee":',
                            vm.toString(paid),
                            ',"sqrtBefore":',
                            q(beforePrice),
                            ',"sqrtAfter":',
                            q(afterPrice),
                            "}"
                        );
                    }
                    row = string.concat(row, "]}");
                    cases = string.concat(cases, bytes(cases).length == 0 ? "" : ",", row);
                    require(vm.revertToState(snapshot), "snapshot rollback");
                }
            }
        }
        vm.writeFile(
            "sequence.json",
            string.concat(
                '{"source":"peachbuild/adaptive-pools@314ed2151367d3edb6f9045f05f5eb18567f5aa6","cases":[', cases, "]}"
            )
        );
    }
}
